title: ‘We are not alone:’ Coalition of UFO whistleblowers call on Trump to let them publicly reveal secrets
description: UFO whistleblowers David Grusch, Dylan Borland, and Matthew Brown want President Trump to waive their NDAs so they can reveal classified secrets.

title: In 1961, a woman described a terrifying UFO encounter in New Hampshire: Her drawing from the incident was later linked to real star system by an astronomer
description: A mysterious drawing made years after a reported UFO encounter became one of the strangest parts of Betty and Barney Hill's story. The sketch, based on a star map Betty said she saw during the alleged encounter, was later studied by amateur astronomer Marjorie Fish, who linked its pattern to the Zeta Reticuli star system, around 39 light-years from Earth.

title: Pentagon Releases New UFO Files Showcasing Alleged 'Flying Saucers' and Secret Defence Tech Research
